security.question: How secure is my financial data?
security.answer: We use bank-level encryption and never store your banking credentials. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest.

platforms.question: Which messaging platforms do you support?
platforms.answer: Currently we support Telegram and WhatsApp, with more platforms coming soon. You can also use our web interface.

family.question: Can I share expenses with family?
family.answer: Yes! Create shared contexts for family, roommates, or project teams. Everyone can add expenses and see real-time updates.

accuracy.question: How accurate is the AI parsing?
accuracy.answer: Our AI achieves 85%+ accuracy and continuously learns from corrections. It handles multiple languages and various input formats.

mobile.question: Is there a mobile app?
mobile.answer: You can use Financy through your favorite messaging app or our responsive web interface. Native mobile apps are coming in 2025.
